UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile document storing basic account information

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated

SavedItem.title: SavedItem
SavedItem.description: A saved work created by the user (e.g., QR Code, OCR text, calculation result, notes)

id.description: Unique identifier of the saved work

userId.description: UID of the owner who created this item

type.description: Category of work (e.g. qr, ocr, calc, note)

title.description: Title or label for the saved work

content.description: Primary content, text, or payload string

summary.description: Optional short summary or preview text

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile collection where only the owning user can access their data

/users/{userId}/savedItems/{itemId}.description: Subcollection containing user's saved QR codes, OCR extractions, and calculations
